result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with absolute wording ('we are committed'). Customers are addressed first and most often, framed around anticipating needs and enabling success. Scale and headcount claims are factual. Headline 'Step ahead. Step beyond.' signals a progress-and-innovation identity. Environment and community appear only in the mission sentence, with no detail or metrics.
